defs.def: to be useful to sb in achieving or satisfying sth 对 … 有用；能满足 … 的需要

defs.def: to provide an area or a group of people with a product or service （向一地或一群体）供应，提供

ex.s: Much still needed to be done before dinner was served, but already outside the building many homeless people were gathering.

defs.def: to work or perform duties for a person, an organization, a country, etc. （为 … ）工作，服务，履行义务，尽职责

defs.def: to spend a period of time in a particular job or training for a job 任期为；担任（职务）时间达；培训期为
to spend a period of time in prison 服（刑）
to give or send sb an official document, especially one that orders them to appear in court 把 … 送达；向（某人）送交
to start playing by throwing the ball into the air and hitting it 网球等
to continue doing sth, especially working or staying in prison, for a fixed period of time that has been set 干至期满；服满刑期
to share food or drink between a number of people 分发（食物或饮料）；（为众人）分餐

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 使用3D打印机,厨师可以在婚礼蛋糕上打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和漂亮的装饰品,不是每个人都可以这样做,这需要多年的经验,而是一个打印机可以让它变得容易. 西班牙的一家餐馆使用Foodini来"重新制作""形式和零碎的"食物,这些食物是"完全相同的",让厨师可以自由完成其他任务. 在另一家餐厅,它服务的所有菜肴和甜点都是3D印刷的,而不是农作摆放.

defs.def: to put food onto plates and give it to people 端上（食物）
